faq.title: Common Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about discovering events on Nuqta
faq.a1: Nuqta is a bilingual (Arabic/English) event discovery and management platform. We help you discover workshops, bazaars, concerts, art exhibitions, and cultural gatherings — all in one place.
faq.q2: How do I find events near me?
faq.a2: Simply browse our homepage to see upcoming events. You can filter by category (workshops, bazaars, concerts, exhibitions, food), search by neighborhood, or use your location to find events near you.
faq.a3: Yes! Browsing and discovering events is completely free. You can book events, save favorites, and leave reviews at no cost. Nuqta only charges event organizers who want to manage their events professionally.
faq.a4: Nuqta is fully bilingual — available in both Arabic and English. All email confirmations and notifications are automatically sent in both languages. You can switch between languages anytime.
faq.q5: How do I book an event?
faq.a5: Find an event you like, select your ticket type, and complete your booking. You'll receive a bilingual confirmation email with all the details. Payment is via bank transfer — simply upload your payment proof and the organizer will confirm your booking.
faq.q6: Can I organize my own events on Nuqta?
faq.a6: Absolutely! Nuqta offers a professional event management platform for organizers. You can start for free with one event, and our system handles automated bookings, bilingual emails, attendance lists, and analytics. Visit our For Vendors page to learn more.

FAQ.title: Got Questions? We've Got Answers.
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know before making the switch
FAQ.q1: How is Nuqta different from managing events through DMs?
FAQ.a1: Night and day. Managing through DMs means you're personally replying to every "is there still space?" message, chasing payment screenshots buried in chat, and spending 10-15 hours on admin per event. Nuqta automates all of this: professional booking pages, instant bilingual confirmations, automatic attendance lists, and a dashboard that shows you everything at a glance. Plus, your events appear in front of 5,000+ active users — people actively looking for events to attend. A group chat can never do that.
FAQ.q2: What if I only organize events once in a while?
FAQ.a2: That's exactly what the free Starter plan is for. Create one active event at no cost, with all features unlocked. Use it for your next event, pause it when you're not organizing, and come back whenever you're ready. Zero monthly fees. When your business grows and you need more, upgrading takes one click — and you can downgrade again anytime.
FAQ.a3: The entire platform is in Arabic and English. All attendee emails are automatically sent in both languages — you never have to translate anything manually. Whether your audience speaks Arabic, English, or both — Nuqta has you covered.
FAQ.q4: How will people actually find my events?
FAQ.a4: Your event goes live on Nuqta's discovery page, which 5,000+ users visit every month specifically looking for events. You also get a custom shareable page for Instagram, Facebook, and anywhere else you promote. Our SEO optimization means your events show up in Google search results too. Think of Nuqta as your marketing engine + management tool in one.
FAQ.q5: What happens to my data if I cancel?
FAQ.a5: Your data belongs to you — always. Export everything (attendees, sales, reviews) from your dashboard anytime. If you cancel, we keep your data safe for 90 days in case you come back. After that, we delete it securely upon request. No data hostages, no lock-in. You're always in control.
FAQ.q6: Do I need any technical skills?
FAQ.a6: If you can use Instagram, you can use Nuqta. Seriously. Our platform is designed for event organizers, not developers. Create your first event in minutes. If you ever get stuck, our support team responds in under 2 hours.
FAQ.q7: How does the bilingual system work?
FAQ.a7: Like magic, honestly. You enter your event details once. Every email, confirmation, and notification is automatically sent in both Arabic and English to your attendees. No duplicate work, no manual translation. Your events look professional in both languages without any extra effort.
FAQ.q8: What payment methods can attendees use?
FAQ.a8: Currently, attendees submit payment via bank transfer and upload their proof directly through the platform. You verify and manage everything from your dashboard — no more digging through scattered screenshots in DMs. Integrated payment gateway is coming soon.
FAQ.q9: How does the verified review system protect me?
FAQ.a9: Only people who actually attended your event can leave a review. Period. No fake accounts, no competitor sabotage, no drive-by 1-star reviews. Every review on your profile is from a real person who was really there. Your reputation stays authentic and trustworthy.
FAQ.q10: Can I try everything before paying?
FAQ.a10: Absolutely. The free Starter plan gives you full access to every feature with 1 active event. Test the entire platform — bookings, emails, analytics, everything. When you're convinced (and you will be), upgrade for more events.
FAQ.q11: Am I locked into a contract?
FAQ.a11: Never. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel with one click from your dashboard. No contracts, no cancellation fees, no awkward phone calls. If you upgrade, new features kick in immediately. If you downgrade, the change applies at your next billing cycle. Complete freedom.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1_desc: We collect information you provide directly to us when you create an account, register for an event, or communicate with us. This may include your name, email address, password, and information about the events you organize or attend.
Privacy.s2_desc: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, including to process event registrations, provide customer support, and send you technical notices and security alerts.
Privacy.s3_desc: We do not share your personal information with third parties except as described in this policy, such as when you register for an event and we share necessary details with the event organizer to facilitate your attendance.
Privacy.s4_desc: We use Google Tag Manager (GTM) to manage analytics and tracking tools on our website. Through GTM, we use Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to understand how visitors interact with our site, including page views, session duration, and navigation patterns. We also use Microsoft Clarity to gain insights into user behavior through session recordings and heatmaps. Clarity captures how you use and interact with our website (e.g., clicks, scrolls, and mouse movements). This data helps us improve the user experience. Microsoft Clarity does not collect personal information such as passwords or payment details. For more information, please review Microsoft's Privacy Statement at https://privacy.microsoft.com.
Privacy.s5_desc: Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies set by third-party services such as Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity. These cookies help us analyze website traffic, understand user behavior, and improve our services. You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings at any time, although some features of the website may not function properly without them.
Privacy.s6_desc: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time through your account settings or by contacting us directly.
Privacy.contact_text: If you have any questions regarding this privacy policy, please contact us at
